:tr: Trace — the sum of the diagonal entries.
:rank: Rank — the dimension of the image.
:span: Span — all linear combinations of the given vectors.
:ker: Kernel — the vectors sent to zero.
:image: Image — the set of values actually attained.
:diag: Diagonal matrix built from the listed entries.
:transpose: Transpose, as an upright sans-serif superscript T.
